title: spacefn database
description: app/db/<name>/config.json: how this database is reached and when it migrates.

driver.description: d1: a D1 database (Cloudflare). durable-object: SQLite inside each Durable Object (Cloudflare). libsql: DB_<NAME>_URL, e.g. Turso, sqld or a file: (both targets).

migrateOn.description: startup: pending migrations apply when the app starts. call: only when your code calls <Name>Db.migrate(), or space db migrate runs.

open.description: startup (the default): databases(manifest) opens it when the app starts. manual: the app opens it with <Name>Db.layer(connection), as for a database per tenant; the infra makes nothing for it, and space db skips it unless --db names it.
